question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

CO_ _ _G_C_ _ _E_E_OL_ _GE
solution:
Given series: CO_ _ _G_C_ _ _E_E_OL_ _GE 

Option 1) LLEEOLLGCLE → CO__**L**__ __**L**__ __**E**__G__**E**__C__**O**__ __**L**__ __**L**__E__**G**__E__**C**__OL__**L**__ __**E**__GE → (It follows the pattern of: COLLEGE - COLLEGE - COLLEGE)

Option 2) CGLEOCOLGEL → CO__C__ __G__ __L__G__E__C__O__ __C__ __O__E__L__E__G__OL__E__ __L__GE → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) COGLECELGEC → CO__C__ __O__ __G__G__L__C__E__ __C__ __E__E__L__E__G__OL__E__ __C__GE → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) LGLEOCOGLGE → CO__L__ __G__ __L__G__E__C__O__ __C__ __O__E__G__E__L__OL__G__ __E__GE → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
